artifacts.name: backfill_manifest_header
artifacts.description: Read the manifest text, apply prepend_manifest_header, and write it back only when the banner was missing. Returns True when the file was updated, False when it already had the banner. Raises OSError to the caller so the CLI layer can decide advisory handling; performs no YAML round-trip so author formatting is untouched.
